title: Purification and functional validation of LtCas12a protein
protocol: Transform 6His-MBP-LtCas12a plasmids (200–300 ng/μL) into competent Escherichia coli BL21(DE3).
Add 500 μl antibiotic-free Lysogeny Broth (LB) medium to the competent E. coli cells and incubate at 37°C, shaking at 200 rpm for 1 h.
Plate 100–200 μL bacterial solution onto an LB agar plate containing ampicillin.
Incubate the agar plate at 37°C for 12 h.
Pick monoclonal colony from incubated agar plate and inoculate in Terrific Broth (TB) medium (100 mL) with ampicillin (50 μg/mL).
Shake the monoclonal colony medium at 37°C, shaking at 200 rpm for 12 h.
Transfer 20 mL of overnight culture into 1 L TB medium containing ampicillin (50 μg/mL).
Cultivate the culture in the flask at 37 °C at 200 rpm until OD600 reaches 0.6–0.8.
Induce the culture with 0.1 mM sterile IPTG at 16°C at 220 rpm for 18–20 h.
Centrifuge the induced cells at 8,980 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Resuspend and oscillate the cell pellets thoroughly in 30 mL resuspension buffer (40 mM Tris (pH 7.5), 500 mM NaCl, 20 mM Imidazole, and 5% Glycerol).
Store the resuspended cells at −80°C for no longer than 1 month or at −20°C for no longer than 1 week until protein purification.
Lysis the cell pellets thoroughly for protein extraction.
Add 0.35 mL of PMSF (100 mM) into the cell suspension.
Add 4.90 μL of β-Mercaptoethanol (14.3 M) to the cell suspension.
Transfer the cell suspension to a high-pressure homogenizer for disruption at 1000 bar and 4°C.
Perform cell crushing using ultrasonication and pause cycles on ice for 15 minutes with a power setting of 300 W.
Centrifuge the sample at 39,190 × g at 4°C for 1.5 hours.
Collect the lysate supernatant after centrifugation.
Filter the supernatant through a 0.45 μm filter paper or syringe filter.

Equilibrate gravity flow column packed with 2 mL Ni2+-NTA-agarose with 10 column volumes equilibration buffer (40 mM Tris (pH 7.5), 500 mM NaCl, 20 mM Imidazole, 5% Glycerol, and 2 mM β-Mercaptoethanol) at 4°C.
Load the supernatant onto a pre-equilibrated gravity flow column and collect the flow-through fraction.
Wash the column with 15–20 column volumes of washing buffer 1 (40 mM Tris (pH 7.5), 500 mM NaCl, 20 mM Imidazole, 5% Glycerol, and 2 mM β-Mercaptoethanol) at 4°C.
Elute the target protein directly with 15 mL elution buffer 1 (40 mM Tris (pH 7.5), 500 mM NaCl, 300 mM Imidazole, 5% Glycerol, and 2 mM β-Mercaptoethanol) at 4°C.
Place the eluted product into a dialysis bag with an appropriate molecular-weight cut-off membrane (such as 20kDa).
Add 1 mg TEV protease into the mixture contained in the dialysis bag.
Seal the dialysis apparatus at both ends and incubate in a 2 L beaker filled with dialysis buffer (20 mM Tris (pH 7.5), 250 mM NaCl, 5% Glycerol, and 2 mM β-Mercaptoethanol) for 24 hours at 4°C.
Analyze the products through sodium dodecyl sulfate-polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (SDS-PAGE).
Load the dialysis solution onto the Ni2+-NTA resin column gently.
Collect the flow-through fraction from the column as the targeted protein without His tag.
Wash the column with washing buffer 2 (20 mM Tris (pH 7.5), 250 mM NaCl, 20 mM Imidazole, 5% Glycerol, and 2 mM β-Mercaptoethanol).
Elute the column with elution buffer 2 (20 mM Tris (pH 7.5), 250 mM NaCl, 500 mM Imidazole, 5% Glycerol, and 2 mM β-Mercaptoethanol).
Conduct SDS-PAGE analysis for all step products.
Equilibrate SP Sepharose HP cation exchange column with 5–10 column volumes buffer A (20 mM Tris, pH 7.5, 250 mM NaCl, and 5% Glycerol).
Pump the protein solution into the column for purification at a flow rate of 2.5 mL/min.

Elute the column with a continuous linear NaCl gradient from 0.25 to 1 M concentrations (buffer A: 20 mM Tris, pH 7.5, 250 mM NaCl, and 5% Glycerol; buffer B: 20 mM Tris, pH 7.5, 1 M NaCl, and 5% Glycerol) at a flow rate of 2.5 mL/min for 50 min.
Collect the eluents using an automatic fraction collector in EP tubes named from A1 to A15, B1 to B15, C1 to C15, etc.
Analyze peak fractions by SDS-PAGE.
Pooled peak fractions from ion exchange chromatography together.
Concentrate protein product to 2 mL via a 100 kDa ultrafiltration tube and centrifugation at 3000g and 4°C.
Equilibrate Superdex200 pg 16/200 gel filtration column.
Use the protein purifier for further protein purification and inject the concentrated protein product into the gel filtration column.
Wash the column with SEC buffer (20 mM Tris (pH 7.5), 250 mM NaCl, and 2 mM β-Mercaptoethanol).
Collect the eluents using an automatic fraction collector, 1.8 mL per EP tube named from A1 to A15, B1 to B15, C1 to C15, etc.
Analyze the peak fractions by SDS-PAGE.
Concentrate protein product to targeted protein concentration via 100 kDa ultrafiltration tube and centrifugation (3000g, 4°C).
Measure the final LtCas12a protein concentration using bicinchoninic acid (BCA) protein assay and store it at −80°C.
Add the storage buffer (20 mM Tris (pH 7.5), 250 mM NaCl, and 5% Glycerol) into the concentrated protein solution to get the required concentration.
Incubate the in vitro cleavage mixture containing 0.3 μL LtCas12a (10 μM), 0.3 μL crRNA (10 μM), and 1 μL 10× NEBuffer 2.1 at 37°C for 10 min.
Add 200 ng dsDNA substrates into the reaction system, bringing the total volume to 10 μL, and incubate at 37°C for 15 min.
Digest the reaction mixture with proteinase K for 15 min.
Subject the digested reaction mixture to agarose gel electrophoresis (AGE).
Incubate 2 μL LtCas12a (10 μM), 2 μL crRNA (10 μM), and 2 μL 10× NEBuffer 2.1 at 37°C for 10 min to form ribonucleoproteins (RNPs).
Add 5′-FAM-ssDNA-BHQ-3′ reporter and target dsDNA into the RNP mixture (total system volume of 20 μL).
Read and record the fluorescence signal at 485 nm excitation and 535 nm emission using a qPCR machine at 37°C.
Incubate 2 μl LtCas12a (10 μM), 2 μl crRNA (10 μM), and 2 μl 10× NEBuffer 2.1 at 37°C for 10 minutes to form RNP.
Add the 5′-FAM-ssDNA (TTATT)-Biotin-3′ reporter and target dsDNA into the RNP mixture (final concentration of 350 nM, total volume of 20 μL).
Incubate the solution at 37°C for 30–50 minutes.
Mix 20 μl reaction with 80 μl strip buffer for 10 minutes.
Load onto the strip and keep it at 25°C for 5 minutes.
Photograph and record the result.
